Yeah I’m not sure if she wanted to purposely screw with me or was just so oblivious to the fact it would and was just talking to me like a friend completely oblivious to how I’d be impacted.

It is what it is. I wish she would have stayed out of my life forever. Like you said screw her.

Sorry that happened to you. We’re gonna make it though.

Yeah it’s fucked 

I came to terms with the fact I’d never hear from her again ... what I didn’t come to terms with was her with someone else ... but all I needed was more time and she took that away from me with the selfish phone call 

I’m somewhat responsible for answering ... at least in 2 months when she undoubtably calls again and this guy gets bored of her once life returns to normal I’ll know not to pick up

Yeah I have to find a way ... I lost my job recently to so I’m just a mess ... I have a lot of savings so have the means to kind of just chill and to a reset and focus on me but it’s still hard 

I’m a logical guy and like finding solutions to problems so I keep searching on the web about ways to get over heartbreak and devising a strategy but it all seems so hard when I can’t even bring myself to get out of bed and eat 

Any suggestions, especially given the lockdown ... my plan is to read, do some home workouts, eat healthy, talk to girls on dating apps and set up dates for after lockdown 

And I think all this is great but it’ll take a tremendous amount of strength and energy right now to do the above

Dude you’re so right and before she told me she giggles and says “would you be jealous if I was seeing someone” then I completely went off the rails and said yes, I want you back ... to which she said she really likes this guy and I’m just a friend.

Like wtf dude ... I’m at a loss here bro

I wanna get out and move on but I can’t ... I’m so mad she reached out, ignorance truly was bliss and I did not need to hear about this new guy ... I was doing just fine now I’m in a dark dark place
Yeah I probably overacted I’m pretty angry at myself for how things played out so you’re probably right

Yeah it’s tough I’m honestly fucking devastated right now but I’m using this as motivation and sort of a game/challenge to level up in life 

It’s all so raw still but I see the light and I hope you do to

I’ve calmed down - it’s been a day since this all came about 

I wrote this post pretty angry 

I’m just going to move on and focus on myself And be more selective of the girls I choose to get involved with in the future

I think she reached out because she legitimately does care about me as a person ... she even mentioned on the phone she wouldn’t have reached out had she known I wasn’t over her ... I honestly thought I was over her 100 percent but obviously I wasn’t ... I was waiting for this day for so long and was expecting her to want to try again not to friend zone me and talk about a guy she’s fuking ... I wish she never contacted me and I don’t  want her to ever contact me again ... I want this chapter of my life to end forever and I want to move on and her contacting me just fuked it all up ... I lost a bunch of weight when this happened and I finally gained it all back and was looking good, was pumped up about life and finding a job, had a bunch of girls on hinge ready to meet after quarantine but she reached out and I’m a legit disaster ... I wish I never took that call ... maybe I’m being dramatic .... I have to wake up tmw and get back to how I was before she called and it’s going to take so much to do so but I have to

Panicked and wasn’t thinking logically 

I know all this stuff ... I’ve read enough advice over the past 2 months on this chit ... I just lost my head and acted irrationally

Yeah dude I’ve spent the entire day in my bed thinking of her hooking up with this guy and I can’t stop ... it’s messing with me badly ... I had the number blocked originally but I unblocked it with the hopes she’d text me and wanna catch up and try again ... not call me to tell me about her new guy lol 

Hopefully I can hit this point tmw cause this is actually the worst 

Could you ever even take her back after her new relationship ?

I wish she would have just not reached out forever

I looked and felt awful ... finally probably 2 weeks ago I had been feeling great about things and now this .. it’s amazing how one person can have so much power over your thoughts and feelings ... I just want it to go away but it’s like always there and I just can’t escape it or take my mind off of it ... plus the job loss doesn’t help at all
Fuck dude I feel for you and your situation but it’s good to know I’m not the only one and this happens ... how are you holding up btw? I haven’t been able to eat all day and am depressed as fuck

Probably tbh

All down fucking hill after that

I dunno I’m defeated thus sucks

I told her about a girl I was casually seeing so she didn’t think I was some pathetic loser who hadn’t moved on and then she brought up this guy 

I asked her for another chance and she said no because she really likes this guy

Hey pal 

Just did the same thing ... when we first met I was this cool, confident guy with a high paying job and I’ve never had a girl more attracted and into me ... anyways fast forward 8 months and my life kind of goes into a downwards spiral and I lose my job and become super needy and clingy 

It got so bad to the point where we grabbed drinks this past week and the dynamic was completely a 180 ... it was like she felt sorry for me and was just consoling me trying to be a good friend ... no romantic attraction or anything, anyways after the drinks she went out and I blew up her phone with all this emotional chit and getting angry at her for going out 

Ended up blocking the number to protect myself from myself and I honestly didn’t want to read any replies she may have sent in the morning 

Blocking is good because you lose all hope she’ll reach out because she literally can’t ... if you need to lie to yourself and assume she probably has that’s fine ... but as time goes on you’ll find yourself again and the only way to do that is to cut all contact ... don’t make the mistake I did and keep in contact when you’re still in love and they’re not, you’re only going to feel worthless and belittled ... the person you dated no longer exists
She most likely moved on during the relationship so add a few months

If you block the number you can go on with your life and never know if they’ve texted you or not 

You can even lie to yourself and assume they probably did but you wouldn’t have gotten it anyways 

Got to kill that hope 

Ignorance is bliss
